title: Write Number Riddles
originalGoal: Apply place value reasoning to WRITE and solve original number riddles.

teacherRubric.required: The learner personally creates a novel solvable number riddle, not merely verifies a generated one.
Every written clue is mathematically true and applicable to the same intended number.
The original 2021 source uses one secret number 1–120 and four clues; accurate tens and ones including 100–120, comparisons, and a final addition-expression clue.
The given target satisfies all clues; reject false equalities and inconsistent arithmetic.
A different learner can understand the clues and attempt a justified solution.
The teacher checks an actual authenticated learner artifact and documents substantive feedback and its evidence.

numericDigitalCheckScope: The source-goal U08 L10 Practice family checks one HYPOTHETICAL RIDDLE only; passing it never certifies student-authored work.
notes: First-party recommended review criteria, not a copied publisher rubric or claimed teacher/UAT decision.
originalTeacherTaskScope: Original 2021 Grade 1 U08 L10: write a number riddle for a secret number 1–120 using FOUR clues, last one an addition expression; an actual partner or teacher evaluation is not falsely claimed before deployment.
